title: PowerA Wireless Controller - Xbox Series X|S - Borderlands SE

comparisons.notes: Manufacturer page with Style = Borderlands SE (SKU XBGP0480-01) at $99.99, in stock, same specs (1200mAh battery, 10 ft cable).

writeup: The Borderlands SE edition of PowerA's wireless controller for Xbox Series X|S (model XBGP0480-01) is new on Woot for $39.99, while PowerA's own store lists the same style at $99.99. It has Hall Effect sticks and triggers, four mappable back buttons and a 1200mAh rechargeable battery. Woot limits it to one per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN from Woot offer data, confirmed as the Borderlands SE PowerA controller by the price checker.
